It is defined by the high expression of MHC class II genes (*HLA-DRA*, *HLA-DRB1*, *HLA-DPB1*, *HLA-DQA1*), pan-macrophage markers (*LYZ*, *AIF1*, *TYROBP*), and specific interstitial macrophage markers such as *CD14*, *CD163*, *MRC1* (CD206), *FN1*, and *C1QA*. The absence of alveolar macrophage markers (like *FABP4* and *MARCO*) and classical monocyte markers (like *S100A8* and *S100A9*) further distinguishes this population as lung (interstitial) macrophages.
